# Renovate Design

> Renovate Design is a home renovation company based in Glasgow, Scotland, serving Glasgow, Renfrewshire and Inverclyde. We design and manage kitchen, bathroom, joinery and interior design projects from first sketch to final finish, and can coordinate other trades (plumbers, gas engineers, electricians, plasterers, tilers and bricklayers) so clients only need one point of contact.

## Services

- Kitchens: https://www.renovatedesign.co.uk/kitchens — kitchen design, supply and fitting, worktop replacements
- Bathrooms: https://www.renovatedesign.co.uk/bathrooms — full bathroom renovations, wet wall and tiled finishes
- Joinery: https://www.renovatedesign.co.uk/joinery — flooring, skirting, fitted wardrobes, doors, decking, panelling
- Interior Design: https://www.renovatedesign.co.uk/interiors — interior design consultation and aesthetic planning
- Home Extensions: https://www.renovatedesign.co.uk/home-extensions-glasgow — project-managed home extensions in Glasgow
- Trade Supply: https://www.renovatedesign.co.uk/trade-supply
